notes.band_corpus_precedence_judgment_call: Mission step 1 says derive 3-tier membership from band_corpus.jsonl + wellposed_all_with_passk.json's nested pass_at_k_results.label, 'band_corpus taking unconditional precedence' -- the same phrase v3.py's resolve_hinted_tier uses for a DIFFERENT, narrower purpose (P3/P4 tier-bucketing of an already-selected small uid set). Applied literally here (all 293 band_corpus uids forced to tier=band) it would inflate band to 400 and the universe to 952, contradicting the mission's own stated 317/405/199/921 AND the hard-pinned universe_n:921 assert. 83 of band_corpus's 293 uids disagree with wellposed_all's nested label (210 agree as band; 37 wp=collapse, 31 wp=solved, 15 wp=misdirection). Decisive check: census_scope.json + former_holdout_map.json (required prior-built foundational artifacts) already label these 921 records, and for every one of the 52 checkable disagreement uids (the other 31 are wp=solved, correctly out of scope), the census/withheld label agrees with wellposed_all 100% of the time (0/52 agree with band_corpus's forced band). DECISION: tier = wellposed_all's nested label (census_scope/former_holdout_map's own label field, confirmed identical); band_corpus precedence NOT applied to tier classification. Surfaced, not silently resolved -- see disagreement uid list in out/analysis/split_build_20260801/universe_master.json cross-referenced against band_corpus.jsonl.
notes.verifier_fix_race: Step 2's live ungradeable screen (from icepick.processing.pass_at_k.verifier import classify, verify) was run once, read-only, and found 0/921 ungradeable -- NOT the mission-expected 21 (18 misdirection/3 collapse). Cause: git commit 0aae56e ('pass@k: verifier infinity fix (R4)', author RedHairing217 <nicky.stump@gmail.com>, 2026-08-01T01:42:59-07:00) landed the R4 infinity fix during this task's execution -- the exact race the mission's step 2 warned about, except the fix WON the race. The commit message itself confirms: 'the 21 censused non-drop ungradeable records (18 misdirection / 3 collapse, all tier number) all self-verify post-fix' and 'Landed BEFORE the new base ruler per R4 ruling -- instrument consistent for the whole campaign.' Independently reconstructed the pre-fix list from the current (fixed) code's own infinite-operand predicate (finite path is byte-unchanged per the commit) and got exactly 21 (18 misdirection/3 collapse) -- byte-for-byte matching both the mission's expectation and the commit's own claim (out/analysis/split_build_20260801/ungradeable_reconciliation.json). DECISION: used the FRESH (empty) list operatively, since Nicky's own commit states the fix is intended active for 'the whole campaign', which chronologically includes P2.
notes.proofless_vs_skeleton_stated_129_186_104: Naive complement (tier_total - proof_bearing, proof_bearing itself reconciling EXACTLY to the ruled 187/217/87) gives band=130/collapse=188/misdirection=112, not the skeleton's stated 129/186/104. Collapse (-2) and misdirection (-8) are FULLY and exactly explained by 'matched proof but stale-self-verify-false' records (2 collapse + 8 misdirection; a STRICT SUBSET of the 21 pre-fix ungradeable, which also includes 11 unmatched-and-self-verify-false records that do NOT explain any part of this gap) -- i.e. Nicky's original 186/104 appear to have been computed pre-fix by also excluding matched-but-then-unconfirmable records from the eval-candidate pool. Those specific 10 records are NOW cleanly gradeable post-fix (commit 0aae56e), so this build did NOT apply that exclusion (see decision below) -- band's own 1-record gap (130 vs 129) has NO identified mechanism: not the verifier fix (0 band records affected, confirmed), not a duplicate/union-cardinality issue (triple-independently-confirmed 317 exact), not a proof-bearing miscount (187 exact, three-way verified). Most likely a minor arithmetic slip in the skeleton, akin to its self-acknowledged 96-vs-97 misdirection discrepancy. DECISION: used the naive complement (130/188/112) as the base eval-candidate pool, applying ONLY the two exclusions step 3 explicitly names (ungradeable-by-name, paper-conflict) -- not a third, inferred 'matched-not-self-verified' exclusion that is itself now stale. This is moot for collapse/misdirection's FINAL counts in practice: paper-conflict shrinks both pools far below where this 2-8 record difference would matter (collapse pool 150 vs quota 97; misdirection pool 85, already short of 96 regardless). It is NOT moot for band, which takes ALL eligible: this build's band eval = 104 (post paper-conflict), not capped to 129 or 130.
